caption: The drawing depicts four distinct metallic plaques or badges, each displayed separately on a plain beige background. At the top is an oval-shaped plaque with a dark metallic appearance, featuring an image of a steam-powered fire engine and the words "UNITED FIREMEN'S INS" arranged around the upper perimeter. Below it, in the center, is a square plaque displayed on its point (diamond orientation) framed by crossed wooden-like rods, with a central symbol that resembles an eye over a horizontal bar, all rendered in similar dark metallic tones. On the lower left is another oval plaque, showing a detailed tree with broad foliage and a textured trunk, with the same dusky metallic color. On the lower right, there is an oval plaque featuring a lighthouse with a coiled fire hose at its base, and the letters “FI” to the left of the lighthouse and “Co” underneath the hose on the right, all elements depicted in the same color scheme. The overall composition arranges the objects vertically, with the square plaque centrally positioned among the three ovals.
title: Firemarks
